summary: TB-EM-002 Center Applications tested on the public preview URL. API: 10 of 11 pytest checks pass. They cover: 403 without the pre-auth token, 400 for an extra 'status' field, 201 for a valid body, 409 for a case-insensitive duplicate email, 401 for anonymous users, 403 for a center admin, start-review, a stale version returning 409, short rationale 400, approve leaving the centers count unchanged with AWAITING_PROVISIONING, CSRF 403 on decision, 404 for an unknown id and 400 for a bad uuid. One bug: a rationale padded with whitespace returns 500. Frontend: every requested flow passes. Checked: the login-apply-link, the empty-submit validation summary with all 10 field errors, client-side blocks (invalid email, therapists 0 and 501, no specialty, no acknowledgement) with no network call, success with an APP-XXXXXX reference, the duplicate-email apply-error, the platform home metrics and metric-pending-link to ?status=OPEN, tab counts, search by email, name and lowercase reference, the empty state, start review, the 'Choose approve or reject.' and short-rationale blocks, approve, decision-record (decidedBy, rationale, 3 history entries, persists after reload), provisioning-pending with a disabled provision-center-button, the Centers metric staying at 2, the two-tab concurrency conflict message, and center admin access (no nav-applications, applications-forbidden, the detail URL redirects to /access-denied). Responsive: no horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 on /apply, the list, an approved detail and a submitted detail.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error when the rationale is at least 10 characters but under 10 after trimming, e.g. 'no          '. DecisionDto @MinLength(10) checks the untrimmed string. The service then trims it to 'no' and the DB CHECK center_application_decision_complete (length(trim(rationale)) >= 10) fails inside the transaction. The UI blocks this because it validates the trimmed value, but the API should return 400. Fix: add @Transform(({value}) => typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : value) before @MinLength in DecisionDto, or check the trimmed length in decide() and throw BadRequestException. Repro: test_whitespace_padded_rationale_not_500.

minor.issue: limits.hit() runs before the insert, so a duplicate-email 409 or a DB failure still uses one of the 5 hourly submissions per network. Consider counting only successful submissions, or accept this as anti-enumeration behaviour and document it.

integration_issues.issue: load() has no stale-response guard (no AbortController or request id). On first mount it fetches with the default 'OPEN' status, and the URL ?status= effect then triggers a second fetch. Fast tab or search changes can therefore show an older response under the wrong tab. Not seen in testing, but it is a code-level race.

issues: application-status pill stretches to full width because the header uses flex-col without items-start (visible at 320 and 390). Add self-start or items-start.

The duplicate-email conflict reads 'We couldn’t send your application yet — An application with this contact email is already being reviewed…'. The 'yet —' prefix implies a retry will work. Show the 409 message on its own.

After a failed client-side validation, focus and scroll stay at the submit button. The apply-validation-summary is at the top of a long form and off-screen. Focus the summary or the first invalid field (accessibility).

action_items: HIGH: Trim the rationale before validation in DecisionDto, or reject trimmed length < 10 with 400, so that whitespace-padded rationales no longer cause 500
LOW: Add self-start to the detail-page StatusPill on mobile
LOW: Show the 409 conflict text on /apply without the 'We couldn’t send your application yet —' prefix
LOW: Focus the validation summary or first invalid field on /apply after a failed submit
LOW: Guard the applications list fetch against out-of-order responses
critical_code_review_comments: applications.dto.ts DecisionDto: the MinLength check runs before the service trims the value, which mismatches the DB CHECK and causes a 500 (confirmed)
applications.service.ts submit: the rate-limit hit is recorded before the conflict check (minor)
applications.service.ts transition: 'current' is read outside the transaction. This is safe because updateMany is guarded by version and status, but reading inside tx would be cleaner.

Verified: OK. The migration has a partial unique index (one open application per email), a decision CHECK and an append-only trigger. The detail response leaves out contactEmailNorm. Approve does not create a center.

rca of the issue: Repro: as platform admin, POST /api/platform/applications/<submitted id>/decision {decision:'REJECTED', rationale:'no          ', version:1} with CSRF → 500. Cause: class-validator checks the raw 12-character string. ApplicationsService.decide trims it to 'no' and writes decision_rationale='no'. Postgres CHECK center_application_decision_complete fails, and Prisma throws an unhandled error that becomes 500. Fix: normalise (trim) in the DTO through class-transformer @Transform, or validate the trimmed value in the service.
